facilitator.title: My students
facilitator.intro: Students who have shared their profile with you can be opened. Others are shown only with their name.

students.title: Students assigned to me
students.none: No students are assigned to you yet.
students.notShared: Has not shared their profile with you

profile.legend: Each answer shows who it came from. "Student said" is the student's own word. "Teacher saw" and "Teacher guess" are added by teachers and never replace what the student said.
profile.conflict: The student's answer and a teacher's observation are different.

form.hintInt: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
form.errValue: Please enter a valid value for this item.
form.errBasis: Please say how you know this (at least 3 letters).

obs.title: Add an observation
obs.intro: Add something you saw or think. It is saved next to the student's own answers and does not replace them.
obs.basisHint: For example: saw the marksheet, or watched them solve problems.
obs.verified: I saw proof (for example a marksheet)

assisted.title: Record what the student told me
assisted.intro: Use this when the student tells you an answer in person.

recs.intro: Suggestions made for this student. Tell us if you agree. The match level counts matching words. It does not measure ability.
recs.none: No suggestions have been made for this student yet.

status.insufficient_profile: The profile does not have enough answers yet.

endorse.intro: Suggest an opportunity to this student. The student will see it and can choose what to do.
endorse.sent: Your suggestion was sent to the student.

pathways.none: This student has no pathways yet.
pathways.intro: You can update a step for the student. The same order rules apply as for the student.

apps.none: This student has not saved any applications.
apps.internalNote: This is the student's own tracking, not proof.
apps.warning: Confirm only what you have seen evidence of, such as a message or letter from the provider. Do not confirm what the student only told you.
apps.seenEvidence: I have seen evidence of this status.
apps.errSeen: Please tick the box only if you have seen evidence.
